MOD = 10**9 + 7

def count_ways(s, t):
    n, m = len(s), len(t)
    if m > n:
        return 0
    
    # Find all starting positions of t in s
    start_positions = []
    for i in range(n - m + 1):
        if s[i:i + m] == t:
            start_positions.append(i)
    
    if not start_positions:
        return 0
    
    # dp[i][j] will store the number of ways to choose j non-overlapping substrings ending at position i
    dp = [[0] * (len(start_positions) + 1) for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Initialize the dp array
    for j in range(1, len(start_positions) + 1):
        dp[start_positions[j - 1]][j] = 1
    
    # Fill the dp array
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1, len(start_positions) + 1):
            if i < start_positions[j - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1]
            else:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j - 1] + dp[start_positions[j - 1]][j - 1]) % MOD
    
    # Sum up all ways to choose k non-overlapping substrings
    result = sum(dp[n - 1]) % MOD
    return result
